Great beach club
Jan 2025 • Couples
We found this beach club online by chance because we were looking for a hookah bar, and then we were there in the evening. Very nice ambience and the food is quite passable for a beach club.
Since we also liked the beach and the loungers in the beach club so much, we were there during the day on two following days. It's very nicely decorated and the place also has billiards table and a rage killer to pass the time. You can also rent paddle boards, for the sea. We have also repeatedly come into contact with the owner. In my opinion, he could reconsider his pricing policy with regard to the all-day stay/consumption and the loungers, as this is somewhat ambiguous, and we have noticed that some guests were dissatisfied by this because they just misunderstood it. The prices in themselves are fair, though, and the beach area is really nice. We enjoyed our time here:-)

VERY RUDE MANAGER
Jan 2025 • Friends
The manager, Matte, was an extremely rude guy. They served us an amaretto sour, it had whisky in so we assumed they had served a whiskey sour by mistake and asked them nicely to change, he came storming out declaring that an amaretto sour has whiskey in. We explained that generally it’s doesn’t (even showed him multiple websites with the recipe on our phones), to which he stated “I wish you had told me before”. I asked for the menu and showed him that at no point did it state whiskey as an ingredient. Instead of just swapping them out; he continued to be rude, obnoxious and derogatory. I then asked him if he could let us know where the rest of our food was (we had had 2 of the 3 dishes for 3 people for over 10 mins by this point), he continued by stating that I should know that grilled chicken takes a long time. I mean talk about contradicting yourself, if I was magically supposed to know your amaretto sour had whiskey in, was I also supposed to know your chicken would take way longer than the other dishes. Perhaps, in future, wait for the chicken to be ready before you serve the others at the table. We ended up leaving cash for the 2 dishes we had had and walking out. Our lovely waitress ran out to apologies to us. This made it clear that this has happened multiple times. What a shame
